name: Kinetic Legerdemain
body:
Discipline: psychokinesis; Level: Cryptic 1

MANIFESTING

Display: Visual
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range: touch
Duration: 1 rnd./lvl.
Saving Throw: None (object); Power Resistance: Yes (object)
Power Points: 1

DESCRIPTION

You can use telekinesis to make Disable Device checks without a toolkit without suffering the increase to the check DC.

Augment: This power can be augmented in one or both of the following ways.

1. For every additional 2 power points you spend, you gain a +1 competence bonus on your Disable Device checks made with this power.

2. If you spend 6 additional power points, the range changes to Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels) instead of Touch.
